name: Schaeffler India Ltd
title: Schaeffler India Ltd - 505790 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Revenue up 18.8% YoY to INR 2,507 cr but down 5.1% QoQ; Industrial bearings weak on "recalibration" and price competition, while capex is being moderated and inventory built up.

utilisation.quote: the capacity utilization of plant is well above 80%

capex.quote: While we have judiciously moderated our capex spend, looking at the market demand and the portfolio demands, but it does not mean that we are going to cut down our capex.

triggers.label: Competition intensifying, portfolio recalibration
triggers.quote: we see our competition is also intensifying their activity within India

triggers.label: Inventory build-up in Q4 FY26
triggers.quote: There has been inventory buildup and the outlook for coming quarters is better.

triggers.label: Industrial aftermarket slowdown, distributor liquidity
triggers.quote: We have seen a bit of demand slowdown in the aftermarket side of the industrial business, surely.

triggers.label: Price increases from Q2, full recovery ~6 quarters
triggers.quote: We have first batch of price increases realizing from Q2 onwards.

triggers.label: Capacity utilisation above 80%
triggers.quote: the capacity utilization of plant is well above 80%

guidance.quote: it will be in the range of what we had earlier, INR 400 crores to INR 500 crores investment this year.
Currently, it's showing 10% growth, minimum 10% that we are likely to register.

guidance.value: No formal guidance; committed to deliver numbers
guidance.quote: No, Varun. We do not issue a guidance as such.

red_flags.label: Industrial bearings recalibration amid rising competition
Inventory build-up and distributor liquidity stress
red_flags.quote: There has been inventory buildup and the outlook for coming quarters is better.

evasions.topic: Competitor share gains in industrial bearings
evasions.quote: which competitor is taking it, or which competitor is growing is not my quota.
I guess time will tell us how successful we will get in terms of adjusting these cost increases
